notifikace.upozorneniNadpis: What the app reads and why
notifikace.upozorneniBod1: It only reads notifications from the bank apps you choose below. Notifications from other apps are ignored and never stored.
notifikace.upozorneniBod2: From a payment notification it takes the amount, merchant, date and the last 4 digits of the card, and saves a transaction to your FinanceFlow account.
notifikace.upozorneniBod3: Account numbers and full notification texts are never sent anywhere.
notifikace.upozorneniBod4: You can turn reading off at any time in your phone settings.
notifikace.krokPristupPopis: Find FinanceFlow in the list and turn it on.
notifikace.krokBaterie: 2. Turn off battery optimisation for FinanceFlow
notifikace.krokBateriePopis: Some phones (Xiaomi, Samsung, Huawei) otherwise put the app to sleep and it misses notifications.
notifikace.pruzkumPopis: Start the search, open your bank app and get it to send any notification. The app only remembers the app name, not the content.
